items.stem: Wang Zhenyi was sure ______ the lunar eclipse was a natural event, not a sign from heaven.
items.rule: 空前是 sure 这类表确信/情感的形容词，从句成分齐全就用 that，不止这四个词。
items.trap: that 不作成分；what/which 必须在从句里当主语或宾语。

items.stem: Mr Li was glad ______ his students had put the safety rules into practice.
items.rule: glad/sorry 等只是举例：说人的情绪/确信的形容词接陈述事实，都用 that。
items.trap: 事实句选 that；别再塞 what/which；只有表「是否」才用 whether。

items.stem: Scientists were not sure ______ they could use to measure the temperature of boiling water.
items.rule: 空前虽是 not sure，但从句 use 缺宾语 → what：它既连接又作宾语。
items.trap: not sure 后面不一定是 that；先数从句缺不缺成分，缺宾语就选 what。

items.stem: ______ is necessary that every student should know how to deal with pressure before the exam.
items.rule: 真正主语是 that 从句且太长时，句首用 it 占位，从句移到后面。
items.trap: 后面的 that 从句已经当主语，句首只能填 it，别再填 That。

items.stem: It is very kind ______ you to help the old people in the community centre every Saturday.
items.rule: It is + 评价人的形容词（kind/nice/polite）+ of sb + to do 句型。
items.trap: kind 说的是“你”这个人的品质，所以用 of；说事情难易才用 for。

items.stem: It is important ______ teenagers to keep a good habit of reading English aloud every morning.
items.rule: It is + 评价事情的形容词（如 important）+ for sb + to do。
items.trap: important 评的是“早读这件事”，不是人的品格，所以不能填 of。

items.stem: The volunteer asked me ______ I had ever helped at the old people's home before.
items.rule: ask 后表示“是否”用 if 或 whether 引导宾语从句，表示事实才用 that。
items.trap: ever、有没有做过，问的是“是否”，that 无法表达疑问。

items.stem: It depends on ______ our class can raise enough money for the volunteer trip.
items.rule: 介词后面接“是否”只能用 whether，不能用 if；whether 从句可作介词宾语。
items.trap: 看到 depends on 别填 if：on 后面被介词卡住，只能 whether。

items.stem: Could you tell me ______ the science museum tomorrow?
items.rule: 宾语从句一律用陈述语序：连接词 + 主语 + 谓语，助动词不再提前。
items.trap: 别照着问句抄 when will we；从句部分要把 we will 摆回正序。

items.stem: Nobody told me ______ after the science show, so I had to wait outside.
options: where did the two geniuses go
where had the two geniuses gone
where the two geniuses had gone
items.rule: 疑问词后直接跟主语，从句不再倒装，也不用 did 加动词原形。
items.trap: 从句里不能倒装：did/had 后面要先接主语，别再写成问句语序。

items.stem: The reporter asked Wang Zhenyi ______ such an accurate model of the lunar eclipse.
items.rule: 宾语从句先保证陈述语序，再让从句时态呼应主句的过去时。
items.trap: 疑问词后出现 did 就是词序错；主句 asked 是过去时，从句要退到过去。

items.stem: In class, our science teacher told us that light ______ much faster than sound.
items.rule: 宾语从句表客观真理、自然规律时，主句即使过去时，从句仍用一般现在时。
items.trap: 别看到 told 就把从句退回过去；光速是客观事实，永远用现在时。

items.stem: The head teacher announced that the school ______ a science show the next Friday.
items.rule: 主句是过去时，从句的将来要改成 would do，时间状语也随之改写。
items.trap: announced 是过去时，别把 will 原样搬进从句，will 要变 would。

items.stem: Mary said she ______ very nervous before her speech last Friday.
items.rule: 主句 said 是过去时，从句描述过去的事用一般过去时，前后时态一致。
items.trap: 从句有 last Friday，主句又已过去，is、will be、has been 都站不住。

items.stem: ______ I was reading about Archimedes, my sister was drawing a picture of the golden crown.
items.rule: while 引导的时间状语从句常用进行时，表示主从句两个动作同时进行。
items.trap: 两个 was doing 并排出现指“同时”；until、so that 都不表同时。

items.stem: Please speak more slowly ______ everyone in the class can follow you.
items.rule: so that 引导目的状语从句，从句常带 can/could/would；because 表原因。
items.trap: “让大家都听懂”是目的，不是原因也不是让步；even if 会读成“即使大家都懂”。

items.stem: If the rain ______ tomorrow, we will visit the science museum with our foreign friends.
items.rule: if 条件状语从句表将来用一般现在时，主句才用 will，即“主将从现”。
items.trap: 从句里有 tomorrow 也不能用 will stop；主将从现只看从句位置。

items.stem: You will never get rid of the pressure ______ you learn to share your feelings with others.
items.rule: unless 意为 if not，引导否定的条件；主句用将来时，从句用一般现在时。
items.trap: “否则摆脱不了压力”要的是“除非”；填 if 意思正好相反。

items.stem: ______ her life was short, Wang Zhenyi still wrote many important books about the stars.
items.rule: although/though 引出让步从句放句首，主句前用逗号，后面不再加 but。
items.trap: 句首是从句位置，只能放 Although；But 不能这样带从句作状语。

items.stem: Though the young inventor failed many times, ______ he never gave up his idea.
items.rule: though/although 不与 but、and 等并列连词连用；主句直接接主语。
items.trap: 中文“虽然……但是”要拆开，只能留一个连词；此空不填才是对的。

items.stem: ______ the ancient people believed about the eclipse turned out to be wrong.
items.rule: 主语从句缺宾语时用 what：它既连接又在从句中当宾语，that 不能作成分。
items.trap: believed 后面没有宾语，填 that 会让从句断掉；what 才补得上。

items.stem: The trouble is ______ the new machine in the lab keeps making strange noises.
items.rule: 表语从句用 that 引导时，that 不作成分，只把从句接到 be 动词后面。
items.trap: be 后面的从句主宾齐全就该用 that；别看到 is 就条件反射选 what。

items.stem: ______ clever answer the little boy gave to the teacher's question!
items.rule: What a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数 + 主语 + 谓语；how 只接形容词或副词。
items.trap: 空后紧跟单数名词 answer，要 What a；只写 What 就漏了冠词。

items.stem: ______ great progress the volunteer team has made this term!
items.rule: 不可数名词前感叹用 What + 形容词 + 名词，不加 a/an；how 只修饰形/副。
items.trap: progress 不可数，加 a 就错；空后是名词短语就用 What。

items.stem: ______ interesting stories the old artist told us about his childhood!
items.rule: 复数名词前感叹也用 What + 形容词 + 名词；how 后面不能直接跟名词。
items.trap: stories 是复数，What a 立刻排掉；剩下 What 才接名词短语。

items.stem: ______ hard the young scientist worked to make her model of the eclipse accurate!
items.rule: How + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语；中心词是形/副时用 how 不用 what。
items.trap: 空后是副词 hard 修饰 worked，不是名词，所以不能用 What。

items.stem: —______ will the new library be open to students? —In about two weeks, I think.
items.rule: How soon 问“多久以后”，答语常用 in + 一段时间；How long 问持续时间。
items.trap: in about two weeks 是“两周后”，不是“持续两周”，别选 How long。

items.stem: —______ does your class go to the community centre to help the old? —Once a month.
items.rule: How often 问频率，答语是 once a month、twice a week 这类次数。
items.trap: 答语是频率，选 How often；How soon 必须配 in + 一段时间。

items.stem: Be careful with the glass tube, ______ you will break it.
items.rule: 祈使句 + and + 好结果；祈使句 + or + 坏结果，“or”意为“否则”。
items.trap: “小心，否则会摔碎”是坏结果，用 or；填 and 意思会变成“就会”。

items.stem: Alex said, 'We will visit the science museum next week,' so he told me that they ______ the science museum the next week.
items.rule: 直接引语变间接引语：人称跟着转述人改，时态后退一步，will 变 would。
items.trap: said 后转述，will 要退成 would；人称 we 也要改成 they。

items.stem: I'm not sure ______ Uncle Wang will come to the science show or not.
items.rule: sure 在否定/疑问句中表「不确定是否」，从句成分齐全时也用 whether。
items.trap: 别见 sure 就填 that；not sure 表示不确定，从句完整也用 whether。

items.stem: After three tries, the boy was ______ that he could solve the puzzle by himself.
items.rule: 主语是人时用 sure/glad 这类述人形容词；easy/hard 说事情难易，不接 that。
items.trap: easy/hard 描述事情，不能写成 sb is easy that…。
